_combinationRule: A lit lantern's actual burn duration is bottlenecked by whichever of the lantern/oil pair is the lower tier: effectiveHours = min(lantern[lanternTier], oil[oilTier]) - a tier-6 lantern burning tier-1 oil only gets the tier-1 duration, and vice versa. Candle and torch are self-contained (no pairing) and just use their own tier's value directly.
_fallbackRule: For later implementation: when the equipped lantern runs out of oil, it auto-unequips and, if the character's backpack has any torch, one is auto-equipped in its place (consumed from the backpack at that moment, burning for its own tier's duration from there). When that torch burns out, fall back again to a candle from the backpack if any are carried, same as the torch step. If nothing is left at any step, equippedLight goes to null (character is in the dark) - see the session's design discussion for the full settle-function shape (litAt-based, cascading forward through time, resolved lazily whenever the next backend request touches the character rather than on a schedule).
